text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup! One, two, one, two, mun, mun, threeee!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whew! You're sure in a good mood today, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yup. That's because today's a special day… It's Mun Mun Day!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun Mun Day is the day when my parents' restaurant gives out free sides. Things like meatballs and fried chicken.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I used to always be so busy helping out that even now, whenever the special day comes along, my body gets all excited all by itself! Like mun, mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Which is all to say… I'm gonna go for seconds on my training today!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, now! Don't push yourself too hard, m'kay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ei, mun! Ei, mun! Ei, ei, muuun!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I can't even see her anymore. Mun Mun Day sure is fearsome…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser seems more focused than usual today. She even does some extra training after she finishes running.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm fine! Ei, mun! Ei, mun!
